    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []

    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        edges = defaultdict(list)
        degree = [0] * (n + 1)
        pieces = []
        
        for _ in range(n - 2):
            a = int(input[index])
            b = int(input[index + 1])
            c = int(input[index + 2])
            index += 3
            pieces.append((a, b, c))
            edges[a].append(b)
            edges[a].append(c)
            edges[b].append(a)
            edges[b].append(c)
            edges[c].append(a)
            edges[c].append(b)
            degree[a] += 1
            degree[b] += 1
            degree[c] += 1
        
        start = None
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if degree[i] == 1:
                start = i
                break
        
        visited = [False] * (n + 1)
        stack = [start]
        ordering = []
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if not visited[node]:
                visited[node] = True
                ordering.append(node)
                for neighbor in edges[node]:
                    if not visited[neighbor]:
                        stack.append(neighbor)
        
        p = ordering
        q = []
        used_pieces = set()
        for i in range(n - 2):
            for j, (a, b, c) in enumerate(pieces):
                if j + 1 not in used_pieces and ((p[i] == a and p[i + 1] == b and p[i + 2] == c) or
                                                   (p[i] == a and p[i + 2] == b and p[i + 1] == c) or
                                                   (p[i + 1] == a and p[i] == b and p[i + 2] == c) or

                                                    (p[i + 2] == a and p[i] == b and p[i + 1] == c) or
                                                    (p[i + 2] ==a and p[i + 1] == b and p[i] == c)):
                    q.append(j + 1)
                    used_pieces.add(j + 1)
                    break
        
        results.append(f"{' '.join(map(str, p))}")
        results.append(f"{' '.join(map(str, q))}")

    print('\n'.join(results))
